h1: Calculate Your Minimum Retirement Pension & Bonus
description: Calculate Argentina's minimum retirement pension (ANSES) and complementary bonus for 2026. Check your total benefits instantly.
intro: Argentina's minimum retirement pension (**haber mínimo jubilatorio**) is the floor benefit administered by **ANSES** — the country's Social Security Administration — for retirees who reach the minimum contribution years under Law 24.241. Since 2024, the base amount is adjusted monthly by the consumer price index (IPC) to keep pace with Argentina's inflation. Eligible retirees whose pension falls at or near this floor also receive a **complementary bonus** (bono complementario), a discretionary monthly add-on. This calculator returns the **total monthly benefit in Argentine pesos (ARS)**, combining the base pension with the bonus if you qualify. It is designed for retirees, family members, and anyone reviewing ANSES settlements.
keyTakeaway: Total = **base minimum pension (ARS) + complementary bonus** (if eligible). ANSES updates the minimum monthly via IPC adjustments. Retirees also receive a 13th-month payment (aguinaldo) split between June and December, plus automatic PAMI healthcare coverage.

**Retirement income planning** uses universal mathematical principles (understanding pension structures, time value of money, income optimization). This calculator applies standard industry formulas for pension calculations.

## How it's calculated

ANSES minimum pension plus complementary bonus if applicable.

This calculator applies the formula using the values you enter, checking typical ranges and alerting when values fall outside reasonable thresholds.

## Investment principles

- **Stick to your plan** during market crises. Emotion is the worst advisor.
- **Diversify**: don't concentrate in a single asset, sector, or country.
- **Keep costs low**: expense ratios >1% annually eat 30% of returns over 30 years.
- **Long time horizon**: equities work in 10+ year periods, not 1 year.
- **Rebalance annually**: once per year is sufficient.

## Important notes

This calculation is a reference only. For critical decisions (financial, medical, legal), consult with a specialized professional. Values are current as of 2026 and reviewed periodically.

faq.q: What is Argentina's minimum retirement pension for 2026?
faq.a: Based on monthly inflation adjustments (IPC), the minimum updates regularly to keep pace with the cost of living.
A fixed amount added if your pension falls below a certain threshold to help low-income retirees.

faq.q: Does the minimum pension increase annually?
faq.a: Yes, through monthly inflation adjustments (IPC) implemented since 2024.

faq.q: Who qualifies for the complementary bonus?
faq.a: Those receiving ANSES pensions near or at the minimum threshold amount.
Yes, retirees receive half their regular pension in June and December.

faq.q: What is PUAM (Universal Pension for Older Adults)?
faq.a: A universal pension providing 80% of the minimum retirement pension for those aged 65+ without employment contributions.

faq.q: Do retirees get automatic healthcare coverage?
faq.a: Yes, PAMI (national retiree health insurance) is automatic for all ANSES retirees.

faq.q: How often does the minimum pension amount change?
faq.a: Monthly through inflation adjustments (IPC), ensuring your benefits keep pace with cost of living increases.
